pet_lore: Born in trench-light and silence, Peewee hears every sound in the dark. Its eye doesn't blink — it remembers, and it holds you in place. Those who lie near it feel dizzy, then weak. Some believe it speaks only once in its lifetime — to deliver judgment. Peewee protects balance, not people. And its balance is absolute. It's less pet, more presence. Less monster, more reckoning. Still, it watches the ones it likes. It remembers kindness.
